trigger: The user explicitly required the approved S02 implementation to be reflected at the actual game entry point through GitHub, rather than existing only as an isolated Step 4 route.

scope.integrationType: same-origin componentized main-entry bridge on the existing kimi branch

requiredIntegration: The root URL renders the same componentized S02 shell used by the isolated route.
The root URL must not use an iframe, object embed, flattened screenshot, or location redirect as the implementation.
The old Canvas runtime entry document is preserved at /legacy.html before root replacement.
The S02 source remains single-authority; root composition must not create a divergent second markup copy.
All active S02 visual layers are explicitly loaded by both the isolated route and the root entry.
Auto, speed, skill cooldown, merchant support and bottom navigation remain functional at the root URL.
Japanese labels remain controlled DOM text rather than rasterized generated text.
A visible load failure state links to the preserved legacy runtime.

rules: root and isolated S02 expose data-testid=s02-shell and data-ready=true
root contains no iframe, object, embed, meta refresh or location redirect
root console and page error counts are zero
reduced-motion and browser large-text simulations retain the primary controls

automaticFailConditions: Only repository files are added but the root game URL still displays the old screen.
The root merely redirects to the isolated route.
The approved screen is used as a single full-screen bitmap.
The old runtime is overwritten without a recoverable preserved entry.
Production alias, backend, payment, ads or permanent player economy are changed.
Step 4 PASS or physical-iPhone PASS is claimed from this checkpoint.
Actual root browser screenshots are absent.
User approval is assumed rather than observed.

completionBoundary.thisAcceptanceMayAuthorize: A verified S02 main-entry integration checkpoint on live kimi and its Preview deployment.
completionBoundary.thisAcceptanceMayNotAuthorize: Step 4 PASS, Step 5, Production, backend, payment, ads, or physical-iPhone PASS.
